description: Ministry  of  Highways & Road Development   -  Order, declare the Barawakumbuka-Mattala Highway as a National Highway
reasoning: This gazette content is an order made under Section 8 of The National Thoroughfares Act, No. 40 of 2008, declaring a specific road to be a National Highway. It contains detailed technical specifications, schedules, and annexes related to the legal declaration of infrastructure. This falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as it constitutes a statutory instrument and regulatory action based on existing legislation, not a government personnel change or organizational restructuring.
